newsitem.title: LEBANON: Israeli planes raid Hizbollah targets in Lebanon.
newsitem.headline: Israeli planes raid Hizbollah targets in Lebanon.

text.p: Israeli warplanes attacked suspected Hizbollah guerrilla positions in south Lebanon on Monday shortly after the guerrillas wounded two Israeli-allied militiamen, security sources said.
They said two planes fired a total of four rockets at hills on the outskirts of Mashghara town, a pro-Iranian Hizbollah stronghold on the southern tip of the eastern Syrian-controlled Bekaa Valley.
There was no immediate word on casualties.
Two hours earlier, two pro-Israeli South Lebanon Army (SLA) militiamen were wounded when Hizbollah fighters detonated a roadside bomb near the town of Jizzine, SLA sources said.
Jizzine is in a strip of territory officially outside Israel's south Lebanon occupation zone but under SLA control.
The sources said the bomb went off as an SLA armoured car was on its way to the militia's position in Tomat Niha. The vehicle was destroyed, they said.
Hizbollah (Party of God) guerrillas regularly attack Israeli and SLA forces in a bid to oust them from the 15-km (nine mile)-wide occupation zone.
